dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For natural dimensions m and n, this is the inductive type of admissible run records described by constructor D003. A record packages dimensions, matrices A, Q, and R, a machine parameter epsilonM, an abstract arithmetic model, inverses of all leading principal blocks of R, and the stated structural and numerical assumptions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target universally quantifies over these run records, so every field and proof packaged by D003 is a standing hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a run, this proposition is the existence of a square real matrix G1 of dimension m satisfying LocalDef004 run G1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: After unfolding, this is exactly the target conclusion: there exists a perturbation matrix G1 carrying the certificate described by D006.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructor forms a run from proofs that 0<m, 0<n, and n≤m; matrices A,Q in R^(m by n) and R in R^(n by n); injectivity of x↦Ax; upper triangularity R_ij=0 for j<i; a real epsilonM with 0<epsilonM<1; an arithmetic model at epsilonM; a two-sided inverse for every leading principal block R_p, p=k+1; the inequalities C(m,p) epsilonM kappa_p^2<1; and first-column computed-norm, normalization, and computed-division identities.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all substantive hypotheses implicit in the universally quantified run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a run and an m by m real matrix G1, this inductive proposition is the perturbation certificate generated by D006.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The existential witness must satisfy every property stored by the D006 certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef005 n is the type of n by n matrices with real entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes R and its leading inverses as square matrices and fixes the existential perturbation G1 as an m by m real matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructor certifies LocalDef004 run G1 from: r=R_00>0; an error delta with r=||a||_2(1+delta) and |delta|≤(m/2+1)epsilonM+c_m epsilonM^2; q_i=(a_i+(G1 a)_i)/r; ||G1||_op≤epsilonM; the one-column residual identity E_i0=e_i; e=-G1 a; ||E[:,0]||_2=||e||_2; ||e||_2=||G1 a||_2; ||G1 a||_2≤||G1||_op||a||_2; and ||G1||_op||a||_2≤epsilonM||a||_2. Here a=A[:,0], q=Q[:,0], r=R_00, e=a-qr, and c_m is the arithmetic model's second-order coefficient.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the full mathematical content required of the existential perturbation witness, including the exact perturbed first-column equation and the norm-bound chain.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real epsilonM, this is the inductive type of arithmetic models described by D024, containing a normalization predicate, a computed division, a computed Euclidean norm, second-order coefficients, and their error guarantees.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each run assumes such a model, and its operations and guarantees determine the computed quantities and error bound appearing in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the computedNorm projection from an arithmetic model, mapping each finite real vector to a real computed norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run assumes R_00 equals computedNorm(A[:,0]), and the conclusion supplies its relative-error representation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the divide projection from an arithmetic model, a binary real-valued computed division operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run assumes Q_i0 is obtained by this operation from A_i0 and R_00.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the normalized projection from an arithmetic model, a predicate on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run assumes every exact first-column quotient A_i0/R_00 satisfies this predicate, enabling the model's division-error guarantee once R_00 is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: LocalDef011 m n is the type of m by n matrices with real entries, equivalently functions Fin m→Fin n→Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the dimensions and scalar field of A, Q, and all one-column matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines C(m,p)=lambda(m,p)+2 mu(m,p), where mu and lambda are D026 and D028. Thus C(m,1)=m+4, while for p≠1, C(m,p)=(7/2)mp^2-(3/2)mp+16p+4sqrt(2mp)+4sqrt(p), with natural numbers cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For every p=k+1 from 1 through n, the run assumes C(m,p) epsilonM kappa_p^2<1.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given 0<n, this constructs the finite index 0 in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every occurrence selects the zero-indexed, hence mathematically first, row or column.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the n by n identity matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The leadingInverse matrices are required to be both left and right inverses of the corresponding leading principal blocks.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: For square matrices R and Rinv, this is ||R||_op ||Rinv||_op using the matrix L2 operator norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its square is the kappa_p^2 factor in every leading-block smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k in Fin n, this extracts the leading principal (k.val+1) by (k.val+1) block of R by retaining rows and columns 0 through k.val.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The run requires each such block to have the supplied two-sided inverse and uses its norm in the smallness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary square-matrix multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the two equations S_p R_p=I_p and R_p S_p=I_p.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the m by n input matrix A from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the matrix whose first column is analyzed and perturbed.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the m by n matrix Q from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its first column is the computed normalized column appearing in the exact perturbed equation.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the n by n matrix R from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies R_00, the triangular factor, and all leading principal blocks.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the arithmetic model associated with a run's epsilonM.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies normalized, divide, computedNorm, and the second-order coefficient used throughout the hypotheses and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Every run carries a proof that n is strictly positive.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees that the first column and R_00 are well-defined.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the real machine parameter epsilonM from a run.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the unit-roundoff-like parameter in all error and perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs an arithmetic model from normalized, divide, computedNorm, and c:Nat→Real, assuming c(m)≥0; for every a in R^m, computedNorm(a)=||a||_2(1+delta) for some delta with |delta|≤(m/2+1)epsilonM+c(m)epsilonM^2; computedNorm(a)≥0; and, if d≠0 and x/d is normalized, divide(x,d)=(x/d)(1+delta) for some |delta|≤epsilonM.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the abstract floating-point assumptions from which the first-column norm and division error properties are obtained.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the nonnegative second-order coefficient function c(m) from an arithmetic model.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes the term c(m) epsilonM^2 to the computed-norm error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines mu(m,p)=1 when p=1 and mu(m,p)=2sqrt(2mp)+2sqrt(p) otherwise, with natural values cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Twice this quantity is included in C(m,p).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that the natural numeral 2 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports elaboration of the real numeral 2 in the exact constants and adds no independent mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines lambda(m,p)=m+2 when p=1 and lambda(m,p)=(7/2)mp^2-(3/2)mp+16p otherwise, with natural values cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first summand in C(m,p).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the m by 1 residual matrix E=A[:,0]-Q[:,0][R_00], so E_i0=A_i0-Q_i0 R_00.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The perturbation certificate explicitly identifies this matrix with the residual vector represented as one column.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m by 1 matrix, this is the Euclidean norm of its sole column.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the explicit equality between the norm of the residual matrix's column and the norm of the residual vector.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the residual vector e with e_i=A_i0-Q_i0 R_00.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The certificate asserts e=-G1 A[:,0] and provides its norm equalities and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: For k in Fin n, this proves k.val+1≤n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It justifies embedding indices of each leading principal block into the full matrix and imposes no extra hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary matrix-vector multiplication, (Ax)_i=sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines G1 A[:,0] in the exact perturbation and residual equations.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the L2 operator norm of a real square matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures leading-block condition factors and bounds the perturbation matrix by ||G1||_op≤epsilonM.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: For x in R^n, this is the Euclidean norm sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures the first input column, the residual, and the perturbation action.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: This represents A[:,0] as an m by 1 matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first term in the one-column residual matrix D029.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that the natural numeral 7 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the real coefficient 7/2 in lambda and adds no substantive assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that the natural numeral 3 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the real coefficient 3/2 in lambda and adds no substantive assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that the natural numeral 16 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the real coefficient 16 in lambda and adds no substantive assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that the natural number 1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports finite indices and one-column matrices of dimension 1 without adding a target hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: This represents Q[:,0] as an m by 1 matrix.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is multiplied by the 1 by 1 matrix containing R_00 in the residual D029.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the 1 by 1 matrix whose sole entry is R_00.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Multiplication by Q[:,0] forms the column Q[:,0]R_00.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary multiplication of conformable real matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q[:,0][R_00] in the one-column residual.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes the dimensions m and n and all finite matrix dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It quantifies the perturbation matrix G1 and the computed-norm error delta.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts division from a division-and-inverse monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the real instance, it gives ordinary real division in coefficients and exact quotients.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses all exact matrix, vector, scalar, inverse, and computed-operation identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes all rows, columns, vectors, and leading blocks.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives the finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the sums in matrix products and Euclidean norms finite and exhaustive.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: This extracts the underlying natural value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses j<i and the leading-block size k.val+1.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.Injective
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function f is injective when f(a1)=f(a2) implies a1=a2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The map x↦Ax from R^n to R^m is assumed injective, equivalently A has full column rank.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous addition operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its instantiated occurrences are ordinary natural or real additions.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous division operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its real instances form exact quotients and rational coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the heterogeneous multiplication operation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its instances supply real multiplication and matrix multiplication in the displayed formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is exponentiation selected by a typeclass.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its occurrences are natural powers, principally squares of real quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the less-than-or-equal relation selected by an order instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses dimension inequalities, nonnegativity, error bounds, and perturbation norm bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the strict-order relation selected by an order instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses positive dimensions, 0<epsilonM<1, triangular index order, positivity of R_00, and strict smallness conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type I, column type J, and entries in alpha is a function I→J→alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This supplies the functional representation and exact dimensions of every matrix.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.mulVec
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix-vector multiplication maps M and v to the vector with entries sum_j M_ij v_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the injective action of A and the action of G1 on the first column.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it interprets squares such as epsilonM^2, kappa_p^2, and vector components squared.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets associativity-related structure from a nonunital commutative ring while retaining the operations needed by the weaker ring interface.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the instance chain supplying real arithmetic to matrix-vector multiplication and adds no hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets commutativity from a nonunital nonassociative commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass infrastructure for standard real matrix arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: This exposes the additive monoid, multiplication, distributivity, and zero laws as a nonunital nonassociative semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the algebraic interface required by matrix-vector multiplication over the reals.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This forgets normed structure from a nonunital normed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It contributes only standard real algebraic instances.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This derives the corresponding nonunital normed commutative ring structure from a normed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects the standard real normed-ring structure to the weaker interfaces needed by matrix operations.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural numeral in a target type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural and real constants appearing in dimensions, indices, matrices, and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 1 using a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real and matrix ones, including 1+delta and identity matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, errors, constants, and arithmetic operations are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard multiplicative, inverse, and division structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives ordinary real division, including A_i0/R_00 and coefficients such as 1/2.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard strict order on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every strict real inequality in the hypotheses and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard multiplicative monoid structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real multiplication and natural powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets products in all scalar bounds and norm formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in relative-error factors, the bound epsilonM<1, and identity matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the real number 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in positivity, nonnegativity, triangularity, and zero matrix entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard normed commutative ring structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ordinary real arithmetic and norm-compatible algebra used by all matrix and scalar expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets the numeral 0 using a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies zero-valued real and matrix entries and zero finite indices.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is ordinary addition on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms dimensions such as k.val+1.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns a homogeneous addition operation into heterogeneous-addition syntax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the displayed additions as ordinary additions in their inferred types.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns homogeneous division into heterogeneous-division syntax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real quotient notation using ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns homogeneous multiplication into heterogeneous-multiplication syntax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets scalar products as ordinary multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This turns a power operation into heterogeneous-power syntax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all displayed powers, especially squares.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard less-than-or-equal order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n≤m and the bounds used to embed leading-block indices.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets positive dimensions, finite-index bounds, and the condition j<i for triangularity.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural numeral as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies exact natural dimensions, indices, and branch constants.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It pairs each existential error witness with both its exact equality and its absolute-error bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given n≤m, this embeds Fin n into Fin m without changing the underlying natural value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It embeds leading-principal-block indices into the full matrix R.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs an element of Fin n from a natural value and a proof that it is below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constructs the zero index used for the first row and column.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines matrix multiplication by (MN)_ik=sum_j M_ij N_jk.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all matrix products, including leading-block inverse equations and Q[:,0][R_00].

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: This defines the square identity matrix, with ones on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the right-hand side of both leading-block inverse identities.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: This maps a natural number to its canonical value in a type with natural-number casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It casts m and p to reals in all explicit constants and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: If n is nonzero, this proves that n+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports numeral elaboration for successor-valued constants and adds no independent target assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: This proves that every successor n+1 is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.succ

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice

dependency_coverage.name: abs

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub

binders: Implicitly universally quantified natural numbers m and n.
A universally quantified admissible run containing A,Q in R^(m by n), R in R^(n by n), a real epsilonM, an arithmetic model, and for each k in Fin n a supplied (k+1) by (k+1) leading-block inverse.
hypotheses: The linear map x↦Ax from R^n to R^m is injective.
R is upper triangular in zero-based indexing: R_ij=0 whenever j<i.

The arithmetic model consists of a predicate normalized, operations divide and computedNorm, and coefficients c(m)≥0. For every a in R^m, computedNorm(a)=||a||_2(1+delta) for some |delta|≤(m/2+1)epsilonM+c(m)epsilonM^2, and computedNorm(a)≥0. If d≠0 and x/d is normalized, divide(x,d)=(x/d)(1+delta) for some |delta|≤epsilonM.
For each p=k.val+1 with k in Fin n, the leading principal block R_p has a supplied two-sided inverse S_p: S_p R_p=I_p and R_p S_p=I_p.
For each such p, C(m,p) epsilonM (||R_p||_op ||S_p||_op)^2<1, where C(m,1)=m+4 and, for p≠1, C(m,p)=(7/2)mp^2-(3/2)mp+16p+4sqrt(2mp)+4sqrt(p).
Writing a=A[:,0], q=Q[:,0], and r=R_00, the run assumes r=computedNorm(a).
For every row i, the exact quotient a_i/r satisfies normalized.
conclusions: There exists an m by m real matrix G1.
The scalar r=R_00 is strictly positive.
There exists a real delta such that r=||a||_2(1+delta) and |delta|≤(m/2+1)epsilonM+c(m)epsilonM^2.
For every i, q_i=(a_i+(G1a)_i)/r; equivalently, q=(I+G1)a/r.
For the residual vector e=a-qr and the m by 1 residual matrix E=A[:,0]-Q[:,0][r], the certificate includes E_i0=e_i for every i and e=-G1a.
mathematical_definitions: Fin n is identified with the zero-based index set {0,...,n-1}; index 0 is the mathematically first row or column.
For x in R^d, ||x||_2=sqrt(sum_i x_i^2). For a square matrix M, ||M||_op is the operator norm induced by Euclidean vector norms.
For p=1,...,n, R_p is the leading p by p principal block of R, S_p is its supplied inverse, and kappa_p=||R_p||_op||S_p||_op.
mu(m,p)=1 if p=1 and mu(m,p)=2sqrt(2mp)+2sqrt(p) otherwise.
lambda(m,p)=m+2 if p=1 and lambda(m,p)=(7/2)mp^2-(3/2)mp+16p otherwise.
The first-column quantities are a=A[:,0], q=Q[:,0], r=R_00, e=a-qr, and E=A[:,0]-Q[:,0][r].
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every admissible run with positive dimensions, an injective m by n input matrix A, an upper-triangular n by n matrix R whose leading principal blocks satisfy the stated inverse and smallness conditions, and first-column norm and division computations governed by the abstract arithmetic model, there is an m by m perturbation matrix G1 with L2 operator norm at most epsilonM such that R_00 is positive and has the model's stated relative norm error, while the computed first column of Q is exactly the normalization of the perturbed vector (I+G1)A[:,0] by R_00. The resulting residual equals -G1A[:,0] and obeys the explicitly certified norm-bound chain.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem quantifies over run records rather than arbitrary matrices. For dimensions or data admitting no such record, the universal statement is vacuous.
Any inhabited run necessarily has 1≤n≤m, an injective A, an upper-triangular R, two-sided inverses for every leading principal block, 0<epsilonM<1, and all leading-block smallness inequalities.
The conclusion concerns only the zero-indexed first column. It gives no corresponding perturbation statement for later columns.
No orthogonality of Q, no global factorization A=QR, and no assertion that the remaining columns of Q or R were produced by a particular algorithm are encoded.
The arithmetic model is abstract. Its normalization predicate and computed operations are otherwise unconstrained, and c(m) is an arbitrary nonnegative coefficient supplied by the model.

Real division in Lean is total even at a zero denominator. The run's quotient and computed-division identities are therefore syntactically meaningful before nonzeroness is known, while the arithmetic model's division-error guarantee is conditional on a nonzero denominator. The conclusion separately establishes R_00>0.
The perturbation G1 is an m by m matrix acting on the first input column, and its size is measured specifically by the L2 operator norm.
Neither G1 nor the relative-error witness delta is asserted to be unique.
Several residual identities and norm inequalities are explicitly stored in the LocalDef004 certificate even when they are definitionally evident or derivable from preceding properties.
